purpose: Preliminary A/B/C workflow demonstration; not final grade validation
review_limitations: A/B labels are visual prototype judgments from contact sheets and selected full-size images.
Class C is a visible-defect/overripe proxy; photos alone cannot confirm juice suitability.
Each consecutive defect range is one capture group, not one independent sample per photo.
Known mold-heavy and visibly rotten sequences were excluded from this selection.
